title: Tunnel B1
overview:
You tear through rock and steel: your only hope. For between the enemy and victory lies a devastating weapon, and between you and the enemy lies Tunnel B1.

Tunnel B1 is a first-person sci-fi shooter. With the city above facing destruction, you pilot a heavily armed hovercraft at high speed through a network of underground tunnels and bunkers, blasting or dodging enemy vehicles, helicopters and gun emplacements. Many sections must be cleared against the clock, weapons can be upgraded along the way, and a full map of each level can be called up at any time.
